executivo.notaLeis_en: We counted the laws the city government published in the “Diário Oficial dos Municípios (Associação Municipalista de Pernambuco - AMUPE)” (an Official Gazette), searching for items with “lei” (law) in the title, from January 1, 2025 to October 26, 2026: 36 ordinary and complementary laws, each number once (republications, corrections and annexes are not counted again; bills, decrees and notices that only mention a law are left out). The few laws the City Council promulgates itself are left out only when the Council publishes them. Each law's date is the one in its title; when the title has none, the year in its number or the publication date is used.
executivo.notaVetos: O número de vetos fica fora: o veto é mandado à Câmara Municipal e a prefeitura não publica no Diário todos os vetos com uma numeração que dê para conferir.
executivo.notaVetos_en: The number of vetoes is left out: a veto is sent to the City Council, and the city government does not publish all of them in the Gazette with numbering that can be checked.
